prose: Business Insider profiles Noah Shinn, the 23-year-old founder of the AI assistant Instinct, noting that he published influential AI research before graduating from college. The publication reports that Instinct soft-launched as an invite-only site for VCs and is reportedly fundraising at a $10 billion valuation, framing the company as taking on Mark Zuckerberg.
highlights: Business Insider profiles Instinct founder Noah Shinn, 23.
Instinct soft-launched as an invite-only site for VCs.
Reported fundraising at a $10B valuation, per Business Insider.
